description: Sign in to ChatGPT Ads Manager through the tenant's hosted browser, because OpenAI publishes no campaign API. Uses the vaulted login_email/login_password of the openai_ads integration and NEVER reports success without landing on ads.openai.com outside /auth/. A second factor, wrong credentials and a Cloudflare challenge are reported as distinct, named outcomes.
name: chatgpt_ads_browser_signin
